author: Kanika
text:
🚨 THIS 100% FREE GITHUB REPO JUST MADE EVERY AI NOTE-TAKING APP POINTLESS.

Drop any source in article, PDF, YouTube transcript, or Journal entry.

Claude reads it, links it to everything in your vault, and files it into a connected knowledge graph on your own machine.

Most tools save your notes.

This one connects them.

Every source gets linked to everything you already know.

Karpathy described the idea - 15 skills. Four vault methods.

Works with Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini.

Most people have years of knowledge buried in folders they open twice a year. This turns all of it into a seco

topReplies.author: Lewin | Wealth Pill 💊
topReplies.text: The real value isn't saving notes... it's connecting them automatically.

topReplies.author: Kanika
topReplies.text: Exactly. Connected knowledge is far more valuable than stored knowledge.

topReplies.author: Pearl AI
topReplies.text: Buried knowledge becoming a second brain is the real flex

topReplies.author: catman
topReplies.text:
a local knowledge graph built from PDFs and journal entries is genuinely useful, but how well does it handle duplicate notes and conflicting claims?  
that’s where “links everything” either becomes research leverage or a very clever junk drawer.

topReplies.author: DeepRead.com
topReplies.text:
Linking everything to everything is noise at graph scale. 

The edges only earn their keep when they reflect your mental model

topReplies.text:
